Kong Tai Hosiery Factory - strike ended

The strike of seventy workers in the Weaving Department
of the Kong Tai Hosiery Factory, a Japanese concern at
1080 Ward Road, which began on March 20, ended at 6 p.m.
March 21, when some 35 strikers resumed unconditionally;
while the remainder reported for duty this morning, March
22. The strike was declared as a protest against the
decision of the management to extend the working period from

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 111/35.
Misc.

Yulin Road Station,
REPORT
Date March 20, 19 35.

Subject Strike at Kong Tai Hosiery Factory, 1080 Ward Road.

Made by J.D.C. 54 Ito. Forwarded by L. Kellaway O/C

Sir,

At about 6.15.p.m. 20-3-35 a telephone message was
received from the Kong Tai Hosiery Factory, 1080 Ward Road
reporting that a number of workers had gone on strike.

From enquiries made by the undersigned and C.D.S. 235 it
was ascertained that the above factory employs 250 workers
engaged in making cotton hosiery. Of this number, 70 workers
in the weaving dept. struck work at 6.30.a.m. 20-3-35 over a
dispute with the management regarding the long working hours,
the strikers demanding better wages.

The manager Mr. T. Enokido interviewed the strikers and
explained to them that the reason the wages were low was owing
to the business depression as he had to sell his products very
cheap therefore he could not afford to comply with their wishes
for higher wages.

It is expected that the strikers will probably resume work
on 21-3-35. a.m.

Enquiries proceeding.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
Toshio Ito
J.D.C.54.

J Knights 21-3-35
G. D. i/c

D.D.C.D.
L.R. 21.3.35.
TG

Copy to I.C.Special Branch.

（批：21 MAR 1935）

日期 1935年3月20日。

事由 华德路1080号公大袜厂罢工。

呈报人 J.D.C. 54 伊藤（Ito）。转呈人 L. Kellaway 主管警官

敬启者，

1935年3月20日下午6时15分许，接获华德路1080号公大袜厂电话报告，称多名工人举行罢工。

经卑职与 C.D.S. 235 查询后查明，上述工厂雇佣有250名从事棉袜制造的工人。其中，织造部70名工人因与资方就长时间工作问题发生争议，并于同时要求提高工资，遂于1935年3月20日上午6时30分停工罢工。

经理榎户（T. Enokido）先生会见了罢工者，并向他们解释称，工资低廉的原因在于商业萧条，他不得不以极低价格出售产品，因此无法满足他们提高工资的愿望。

预计罢工者可能于1935年3月21日上午复工。

调查正在进行中。

此致，
敬礼，
伊藤敏雄（Toshio Ito）
J.D.C.54。

J Knights 1935年3月21日
G. D. i/c

副刑事侦缉处长
L.R. 1935年3月21日。
TG

抄送情报科特别分部。

（批注：1935年3月21日）

March 22, 1935.

Labour (2)

Kong Tai Hosiery Factory - strike ended

The strike of seventy workers in the Weaving Department
of the Kong Tai Hosiery Factory, a Japanese concern at
1080 Ward Road, which began on March 20, ended at 6 p.m.
March 21, when some 35 strikers resumed unconditionally,
while the remainder reported for duty this morning, March
22. The strike was declared as a protest against the
decision of the management to extend the working period from
9 to 11 hours and also to enforce a demand for better wages.

North China Garage - situation

Some 30 chauffeurs of the North China Garage, 108
Nanzing Road, which closed down on March 19 owing to financial
difficulties have been staying since March 20 in the house
of Zien Wen Hao (〔此处转录不清〕), Manager of the garage, at Lane
222, No.20 Avenue du Roi Albert, with the object of pressing
their demands for the immediate issue of wages in arrears
as well as the return of their guarantee money. This garage
in addition to branches in the French Concession and the
head office at Nanzing Road, has a branch at No.1 Pingliang
Road.

Ewo Cotton Mills Ltd. - propaganda in favour of strikers

A printed handbill containing the following demands
was found posted on a wall near the gate of the Yangtzepoo
Cotton Mill, 1 Wetmore Road, in the evening of March 21.

华北汽车行——局势

南京路108号华北汽车行（North China Garage）因财务困难于3月19日停业，该行约三十名司机自3月20日起一直滞留于该行车行经理谢文豪（Zien Wen Hao，〔此处转录不清〕）位于亚尔培路20号222弄的寓所内，旨在施压以要求立即发放欠薪并退还保证金。该车行除在法租界设有分行及在南京路设有总行外，还在平凉路1号设有一处分行的。

9. 应组织罢工委员会。
10. 应反对无条件复工。
11. 应反对资方企图与社会局勾结以破坏罢工运动的行为。

公大袜厂——织造部罢工

位于华德路1080号的日商公大袜厂（Kong Tai Hosiery Factory）织造部七十名工人，为抗议资方决定将工作时间从9小时延长至11小时，并同时提出提高工资的要求，于3月20日上午6时30分举行罢工。截至1935年3月21日今晨，他们仍在罢工中。该厂共雇佣工人250名。
